chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn Umar ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Sa'id al-Qammad, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about enjoying (sexual relations) with the virgins who are between the parents (i.e., daughters), so he said: 'There is no harm,' and he did not say as those coarse/rough men say.
ai.seo_question: Is sexual intercourse with one's own daughter permissible in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the permissibility of *tamattu'* (sexual intercourse) with one's own virgin daughter, a ruling often discussed in the context of the 'Ukhdh' (marriage of convenience) or specific familial unions. He distinguishes his view from that of the *Aqsab* (coarse or rough men), implying that while permissible, it requires a degree of refinement or specific conditions to avoid being merely utilitarian or crude. This narration highlights the nuanced Shia jurisprudence regarding intra-familial marital relations, contrasting with stricter views held by other schools.
